description: This file defines a custom authentication success handler in a Spring Security context, which updates user's last login time upon successful login.

classes.name: UserAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: A custom handler that extends Spring Security's SavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler to update user's login timestamp on successful authentication.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Overrides the default method to update the user's last access and login time, then redirects to the admin home page.
